title: When stairs feel uncomfortable in pregnancy

scenes.caption: Ask for help when stairs hurt
scenes.narration_line: If stairs cause pelvic pain, contact your midwife or doctor for advice.

scenes.caption: Reduce repeated trips if pelvic pain develops
scenes.narration_line: With pelvic pain, reduce repeated stair trips and avoid activities that worsen the pain.

scenes.caption: Pace activities and accept practical help
scenes.narration_line: For pelvic pain, pace daily activities, rest when needed, and accept help with tasks.
safety_points: Wear comfortable, supportive shoes; avoid high heels.

scenes.caption: Ask a physiotherapist about stair technique
scenes.narration_line: If advised for pelvic pain: take stairs one step at a time; less painful leg upstairs, more painful leg downstairs.
safety_points: Use the bannister for support when going downstairs.
Seek medical advice if pain remains severe.
